findings.summary: The evidence channel is never wired through the production assembly, so the harvest step can never run and instead wedges the tick. `--run` requires `--evidence-channel` (src/tick-run.ts:279 throws MissingEvidenceChannelError as soon as a harvest decision appears), but the delivered chain bin/deep-research-loop.sh (exports only TICK_ENTRY/TICK_CHANNEL) -> workflows/deep-research/fleet.yaml.tpl (inputs tick_entry/tick_channel only) -> workflows/deep-research/tick/workflow.yaml (payload tick_entry/tick_channel only) -> tick.md invokes `"$tick_entry" --run "$tick_channel"` with no evidence channel. The moment any in_flight card's run reports exited(exit_code=0) — precisely the case this package exists to handle — decideTick emits a `harvest` decision, runWrite throws, and tick-entry.ts:104-108 exits 2. The card stays in_flight forever, so every subsequent tick fails identically, also regressing the A8b/A8c/A8d `--run` path that previously CAS'd exited(0) cards to explored. This is spec §4.1 discipline 8 (an invariant held at the unit layer is not held on the `--run` production path); the A8c N9 test already established that channel wiring must be proven end-to-end from fleet -> workflow -> template, and that proof was not extended to the new required input. The dev-note claim "`--run` 用法补充 `--evidence-channel`，接线透传" is not borne out: the string `--evidence-channel` appears nowhere under bin/, workflows/, or test/.

H14 (and H13) are accepted only at the unit layer, which spec §4.1 discipline 8 forbids for loud-failure criteria: "本包凡「响亮失败」类判据（H13/H14），验收必须落在 `--run` 的生产路径上，不得只验单元层". Both H14 cases call runWrite() with hand-built WriteDeps; no test drives runChannelWrite() or bin/tick-entry.sh `--run` without `--evidence-channel` to assert a non-zero exit. The only production-path test (H1, test/harvest.test.ts:378-477) exercises the success path with an explicit evidence channel, so the missing-channel failure on the real path is untested — which is exactly why the blocker above went unnoticed.

anchorForEvidence silently substitutes empty strings for a missing source/locator/revision, yielding the degenerate anchor "://@". Because that string is non-empty, assertEvidenceComplete passes and H2's "four required fields present and non-empty" check is satisfied by a meaningless anchor, which is then published irreversibly to an append-only bus with no DELETE. This is the same silent empty-string fallback the codebase elsewhere refuses (see the "解析不到 secret 不得塞空串" rationale at src/tick-run.ts:189-197); missing anchor components should fail loudly instead.

The maxClues cap is evaluated once per card from a pre-tick snapshot (boardClueCount, wired from assembled.clueEntities at src/tick-run.ts:719) and is never incremented as clues are published, so the board can overshoot maxClues. With boardClueCount=63, maxClues=64 and a card carrying 5 proposed_clues, all 5 are published (68 total); multiple harvest cards in one tick compound this. Spec §1.6 requires that once the board reaches maxClues no new clue is added.

readWorkerResult re-paginates the entire board:agent-runs channel once per harvest card, on top of the full pagination readAgentRuns already performed in the same tick. On a channel that accumulates every run event and every worker result this is an O(cards x channel) read amplification; the already-read message list could be reused.
